name: Crushing Mandibles
description: This bug has large mandibles capable of tearing through flesh. These are a natural bite weapon which deals 2 damage. The mandibles may be dedicated to grapples as if they were a limb.

name: Oversized Mandibles
description: This bug's mandibles are incredibly huge, dealing 3 damage instead of 2, and granting a +2 die bonus on checks to grapple or maintain a grapple they are dedicated to. Oversized Mandibles have 1 bulk.

name: Exotic Venom
description: May be taken as a subtrait of any Trait which inflicts DoT as part of a Status Effect. The bug's venom takes the effects of a poison, or a targeted or ingested flask effect, instead of its normal DoT. The bug gains the recipe of their Exotic Venom, and can produce it even without the correct Stash Path. If taken as a Subtrait of Stinger, reduce the Hunger cost by 2.

name: Horn
description: This bug has a large horn atop its head. This is a natural weapon which deals 2 damage. The first successful hit with a horn attack each round also causes one stack of Off-Balance to the target.

name: Irritant Bristles
description: This bug has bristles that lodge into attackers. Whenever a bug hits this bug with an attack from within 3 squares, they are inflicted with a 3-point Status Effect that gives all rolls beside Shell checks a -1 die penalty per 3 points of the status. The bug may also attack with the bristles as a range 3 or melee natural weapon, dealing no damage besides the Status Effect.

name: Natural Projectile
description: This bug can launch a projectile from its body. It deals 2 damage and has a range of 4 squares. This natural weapon has the Sling weapon type.

name: Crippling Shot
description: The projectile deals no damage, instead inflicting a debuff. When this trait is taken, choose a Primary Attribute, Pool, or Speed. When the projectile hits, the affected bug makes a Shell check. The hit lowers the Attribute or maximum Pool by 1 point per 2 points in the debuff pool.

selectableEffects.debuffFormula: 1 point reduction per 2 debuff pool points

name: Fluids
description: This bug's projectile can contain a certain concoction. Instead of its normal damage, the projectile delivers that flask's effects. The bug gains the recipe of their Fluids, and can produce it even without the correct Stash Path.

name: Heavy Shot
description: The projectile deals 1 more damage and is considered a heavy weapon. Can be taken with Crippling Shot, Obscuring Shot or Spray.

name: Obscuring Shot
description: The projectile deals no damage, instead targeting the senses of other bugs. When this bug makes an attack, it chooses a sense to target. The bug hit loses access to the sense via a debuff.

name: Spray
description: The projectile affects a Cone of short, long or wide size. It costs 1 extra tax Stamina to use. It is resolved as an AoE. May be taken with Crippling Shot, Obscuring Shot or Fluids.

name: Natural Secretion
description: During their turn, this bug may spend Stamina equal to the Stash cost of a chosen flask to gain a 2-point Status Effect. While under this effect, the bug applies flask effects to grapplers or melee attackers. The bug is immune to its own secretions.

name: Secretion Trail
description: This bug can release a trail of their natural secretions. Every square moved through is covered by the secretions. When a bug crosses the trail, it is afflicted with the secretion's effects.

name: Natural Tool
description: This bug has a body part that can be used as a certain Tool with 1 Quality. Tools that fill a very specific role may have increased Quality.

selectFrom.note: Enter tool name (e.g., Hammer, Lockpick, Rope)

name: Paralyzing Venom
description: May be taken as a subtrait of any Trait which inflicts DoT. In place of DoT, twice as many stacks of Paralyzing Venom are applied. Paralyzing Venom is a Status Effect with escalating effects based on stack count.

name: Pincers
description: This bug has a pair of formidable pincers at the end of two of its arms. These are natural weapons which deal 1 damage. They have +2 rerolls on grapple checks and deal 2 damage to grappled bugs. Pincers may be used for Unarmed Arts.

name: Oversized Pincers
description: One or both pincers now deal 3 damage instead of 1, and 4 to grappled bugs. Oversized pincers cannot wield weapons effectively or perform dexterous tasks. They have 1 Bulk and are a Tusk weapon.

name: Scythe Arms
description: Two of this bug's arms end in scythes, which are natural weapons that deal 2 damage and can always be paired. Scythe arms can grasp objects but not wield weapons effectively. Count as any one weapon type for Arts.

naturalWeapon.name: Scythe Arms
naturalWeapon.description: Always pairable and receive a free weapon modifier, cannot get more modifiers from advancement.

name: Sharp Claws
description: This bug's fingers are tipped with vicious claws, which deal 1 damage and can always be paired with any weapon. They may hold objects without penalty. When striking as a paired attack, base damage increases by 1.

name: Sharp Proboscis
description: This bug possesses a long needle-like mouth. This is a natural bite weapon that deals 1 damage. It bypasses armor damage reduction and Soak rolls are made at -2. Synergizes with Bloodsucker.

name: Slam
description: This bug is weighted to allow it to throw its bulk around to knock out the competition. If the bug moves at least 1 space toward a target or performs a jump action, it can make a single Slam attack against that target which deals 2 damage. Attempts to parry it are made at -2. Each size category above Small it adds 1 Hunger, 1 damage and 1 bulk to this trait.

name: Spiky
description: This bug is partially covered in spikes, and may use these as a natural weapon dealing 2 damage. Additionally, attackers take damage when hitting or grappling this bug.

name: Stinger
description: This bug has a retractable stinger in its abdomen. This is a natural weapon that inflicts 3 damage over time, but receives -2 to hit unless flying or grappling the target. Stingers are 1 Bulk.

name: Prehensile Tail
description: This bug's stinger is located at the end of a tail, and has no penalty to hit.

name: Tentacle
description: The bug possesses a long, lashing tentacle. It can hold, but not wield, objects. It has Reach and deals 1 damage. The tentacle may be used to grapple at Reach with Might 3. May be taken multiple times. +1 Might per tentacle when dedicated to grapple

name: Venomous Bite
description: This bug's bite becomes a natural weapon capable of dealing 1 damage and inflicting 2 DoT. If it has any form of bite attack, it instead inflicts the DoT through said attack for 1 Stamina. Cannot be paired.

naturalWeapon.name: Venomous Bite
naturalWeapon.description: inflicts 2 DoT, 1 Stamina to activate with existing bite

name: Bloodsucker
description: This bug may drink fresh blood for sustenance. It may draw blood using a 0-damage bite attack; on a success, it gains 5 Belly and the target loses 10 Belly. If the target is willing, incapacitated, or freshly slain, those numbers double and the bug may trigger this ability multiple times, paying 1 Stamina per additional use. This trait may be taken as a subtrait of a natural weapon used for a bite attack; if so, it may only be used with that natural weapon.
